# X

Short formats that work on X: takes, lists, polls and how-tos.

10 templates. Square brackets are placeholders: replace every one before you post.

## You need this, not that (`xDontNeed`)

- Network: X
- Use it when: Name something your audience thinks they need, then give your different take.

```text
You do not need [what people think they need].

You need [what really helps].

[one line on why]
```

## Bold claim, then why (`xBoldWhy`)

- Network: X
- Use it when: State something you believe, then back it up with the reason.

```text
[bold statement].

Here is why it works:

[the reason, a fact or a short example]
```

## Tools and what they cost (`xToolList`)

- Network: X
- Use it when: A useful list for your audience. Adding the prices makes it even more useful.

```text
The tools I use to run [what you run]:

• [tool]: [price]
• [tool]: [price]
• [tool]: [price]
• [tool]: [price]

Total: [amount] a month.
```

## It is not about X (`xNotAbout`)

- Network: X
- Use it when: Turn a common belief around and point at what really matters.

```text
[topic] is not about [common belief].

It is about [what really matters].
```

## Hard truth (`xHardTruth`)

- Network: X
- Use it when: Say out loud what many people know but few say.

```text
Hard truth about [topic]:

[the truth in one or two lines]
```

## Curated thread (`xCuratedThread`)

- Network: X
- Use it when: Collect the best posts, accounts or links on one topic. Add one per post in the thread below.

```text
The best [posts, accounts or resources] on [topic] I found this year.

A thread worth saving:
```

## Quick vote (`xPoll`)

- Network: X
- Use it when: Easy to join, and you learn what your audience thinks.

```text
Quick question for [audience]:

[your question]

A) [option]
B) [option]
C) [option]

Reply with a letter.
```

## Describe it in one word (`xOneWord`)

- Network: X
- Use it when: An easy ask that gets a lot of replies. Good for reach, less so for authority.

```text
Describe [thing] in one word.

I will start: [your word].
```

## Step by step how-to (`xHowTo`)

- Network: X
- Use it when: Turn something you do well into steps people can follow.

```text
How to [result] in [number] steps:

1. [step]
2. [step]
3. [step]
4. [step]

The step most people skip: [step].
```

## Myth vs reality (`xMythReality`)

- Network: X
- Use it when: Take a belief people hold and show what the evidence says.

```text
Myth: [what people believe].

Reality: [what is true].

Proof: [your data, test or example].
```
